finalMessages.content: My queries are really slow — how do I add indexes to speed them up?

content.text:
That's a great question, but it's actually owned by a different node. Indexing and query speed live in the "Indexes and query performance" node — head there and you'll get the full treatment.

What I can help with here is transactions and ACID: how to make sure your data stays consistent when multiple things touch it at once. If your "slow queries" turn out to involve locking or blocking from long-running transactions, that overlaps with my scope — but pure indexing belongs next door.

Want to take a look at transactions, or is speed your only concern right now?
